kangaroo-island-13.name: Pennington Bay
kangaroo-island-13.bio: A white-sand surf beach on the south coast, with a lookout over the bay.
kangaroo-island-13.coordinates_source: OSM natural=bay (Nominatim) 'Pennington Bay'; resolve-pin HIGH but a bay centroid (no natural=beach feature in OSM), may sit at the shoreline
notes: Wikivoyage says 'don't miss Pennington Bay' under Prospect Hill; pin 1.5 km SSE of Prospect Hill

kangaroo-island-14.name: Prospect Hill
kangaroo-island-14.bio: About 500 steps climb Prospect Hill to a 360-degree view, as Matthew Flinders did in 1802.
kangaroo-island-14.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak + tourism=viewpoint 'Prospect Hill', 65 m; Commons photo median within 10 m (resolve-pin HIGH)
kangaroo-island-14.ticket_note: Open lookout climb, no operator page; Wikivoyage also names it Mt Thisby

kangaroo-island-15.name: Emu Bay
kangaroo-island-15.bio: A 4 km white-sand swimming beach with a 100-year-old jetty and boat ramp, on the island's north coast.
kangaroo-island-15.coordinates_source: OSM natural=beach 'Emu Bay Beach' (Nominatim); resolve-pin returned the bay centroid, the beach feature used instead (MEDIUM)

kangaroo-island-16.name: Kingscote
kangaroo-island-16.bio: The island's largest town, with a harbour and the site of South Australia's first European settlement.
kangaroo-island-16.coordinates_source: OSM place=town 'Kingscote' (Photon/Nominatim); Wikipedia article point 255 m away
notes: Destination draft centre (-35.65305556,137.63416667) is ~220 m from this pin: fine, but the destination hub must not reuse the Kingscote spot's exact point

kangaroo-island-17.name: Reeves Point
kangaroo-island-17.bio: The site of South Australia's first settlement, with a lookout, the Mulberry Tree and interpretive signs.
kangaroo-island-17.coordinates_source: OSM landuse=grass 'Reeves Point Historic Site' (Nominatim); Wikivoyage Reeves Point listing -35.6442,137.6383 agrees within 50 m (HIGH)
notes: Mulberry tree/lookout; the Reeves Jetty ruin (-35.64133,137.6412) is ~400 m east, not used as the pin
kangaroo-island-17.ticket_note: Open historic site, no official page verified

kangaroo-island-18.name: Kingscote Pelican Feeding
kangaroo-island-18.bio: Pelicans are fed daily at 5 pm behind the Kangaroo Island Marine Centre, free with donations welcome.
kangaroo-island-18.coordinates_source: LOW: no OSM feature found for this place (Nominatim/Photon/resolve-pin); not guessed
notes: pin: LOW. KI Marine Centre not found in OSM/Photon; Kingscote waterfront, needs agency/operator point
kangaroo-island-18.ticket_note: Run behind the Kangaroo Island Marine Centre; its own site not verified, so no link. Free, donations appreciated (Wikivoyage); 5 pm daily

kangaroo-island-19.name: Kingscote Silo Art
kangaroo-island-19.bio: A 25 m silo mural of a kangaroo and a glossy black cockatoo at Kingscote.

kangaroo-island-20.name: Kingscote Jetty
kangaroo-island-20.bio: A jetty used for fishing and sunsets, with leafy sea dragons around the pylons for snorkellers.
kangaroo-island-20.coordinates_source: LOW: no OSM feature found for this place (Nominatim/Photon/resolve-pin); not guessed
notes: pin: LOW. Nominatim 'Kingscote Jetty' only returns Reeves Point Jetty (ruin, already Reeves Point's area), not the main town jetty

kangaroo-island-21.name: Hope Cottage National Trust Museum
kangaroo-island-21.bio: A National Trust museum in an 1850s cottage, holding the island's settler-era heritage collection.
kangaroo-island-21.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 'Hope Cottage Museum'; second OSM tourism=museum node within 20 m (resolve-pin HIGH)
notes: National Trust page checked (title 'Hope Cottage'): adult $10, child $3, concession $6; open daily 1-4 pm, closed August (not in copy). Cottage built c.1857, so bio says 1850s not 1856

kangaroo-island-22.name: American River
kangaroo-island-22.bio: A fishing village on Pelican Lagoon with a wharf, walks, wildlife and local oysters.
kangaroo-island-22.coordinates_source: OSM place=village 'American River' (Photon); Wikipedia point 1 km north was the lagoon-side town hint only

kangaroo-island-23.name: Red Banks Beach
kangaroo-island-23.bio: Red-orange cliffs about 15 minutes north of American River, best at sunset.
kangaroo-island-23.coordinates_source: LOW: no OSM feature found for this place (Nominatim/Photon/resolve-pin); not guessed
notes: Tourism board page gives no coordinates and OSM has no Red Banks Beach on Kangaroo Island: pin LOW, raise to owner (about 15 min north of American River)

kangaroo-island-24.name: Penneshaw
kangaroo-island-24.bio: The ferry arrival village on the Dudley Peninsula, with the Gateway visitor centre.
kangaroo-island-24.ticket_note: Town; Gateway Visitor Information Centre page not verified
